[[Kehtu]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Turai's Procession}}

==Dialogue==
:''"My beautiful wife, [[Gamyuka]]... I love her so dearly. But, no matter how often I tell her she's beautiful, still she goes on wild quests to restore something she can never lose. Can you do an old man a favor, [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]]? In the wilds you can find [[Sentient Lodestone]] that can be made into a mirror that will show a person's inner beauty, no matter her age. If you can find 5 Sentient Lodestones so that I might make this mirror for her, I will gladly give you anything I have:"  ''
